Claim 1. (Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition detected by the physiological monitor; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor that is perceptibly different from the first alarm.

Claim 16. (Currently Amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to track escalation status of the alarm; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, and escalation status information; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data including the escalation status.

Claim 17. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system and is capable of communicating alarm escalation information between the physiological monitor and the central management system.

Claim 18. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm and tracks whether the alarm has been escalated from an initial state to an escalated state.

Claim 19. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm at each escalation level.

Claim 20. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data including escalation status to one or more wireless devices when the alarm reaches a predetermined escalation level.
